P01.rationale: There is no founder portrait present on this page.

P05.rationale: The client name 'Cordes Consulting' and the project number are clearly framed in a dedicated column with meaningful size.

P10.rationale: The large '02' numeral and the '6 von 6' text act as oversized decorative typographic elements that anchor the layout.

P11.rationale: The page features real data-visualisations including specific numbers like '6', '0', and '18' which are bound to the narrative of automation results.

P12.rationale: The layout is dense and magazine-quality, filling the sheet with text blocks and a structured right-hand column without sparse gaps.

P13.rationale: There is no intentional background texture or atmosphere; the page relies on flat white space and solid color blocks.

P14.rationale: No full-bleed photo is used on this page to require treatment for text readability.

P16.rationale: There are no device or product mockups shown in the layout.

N07.rationale: The imagery consists of generic typographic elements and abstract data blocks rather than specific business photography.

N08.rationale: There is minimal dead whitespace as the content fills most of the available area in both columns.

N10.rationale: Text does not sit on busy photos without a scrim because there are no photographs overlaid with text.
